review_evidence: README states the repository formalizes the Erdos-Stone-Simonovits and Kovari-Sos-Turan extremal graph theorems in Lean.
Inspected the ErdosStoneSimonovits and KovariSosTuran modules: they define graph constructions/bounds and prove the headline asymptotic/extremal theorems.
The 27 primary files are formal graph/combinatorics/analysis modules; no source-local primary file was shown to be a lossless non-formal artifact.
summary: Retain the complete primary Lean development for the Erdos-Stone-Simonovits and Kovari-Sos-Turan formalizations.

review_evidence: Data/Finset/Filter.lean (read in full): imports Mathlib and proves theorem Finset.filter_true, filter by the constant True predicate equals s; a real lemma, not an import-only module.
Combinatorics/SimpleGraph/Bipartite.lean: defines structure IsBipartiteWith and proves lemmas such as IsBipartiteWith.symm, isBipartiteWith_neighborSet, isBipartiteWith_neighborSet_disjoint.
Combinatorics/SimpleGraph/Equipartite.lean: defines completeEquipartiteGraph and proves completeEquipartiteGraph_adj, completeEquipartiteGraph_eq_bot_iff, degree_completeEquipartiteGraph.

Combinatorics/SimpleGraph/Extremal/ErdosStoneSimonovits.lean: contains the Erdos-Stone-Simonovits proof lemmas, e.g. between_verts_isBipartiteWith, card_edgeFinset_between_verts_le, mul_le_card_filter_mul, filter.pi.
Combinatorics/SimpleGraph/Extremal/KovariSosTuran.lean: defines bound and proves card_edgeFinset_le_bound_of_completeBipartiteGraph_free, zarankiewicz_le, symm_zarankiewicz_le.
summary: Inspected all five changed Lean files. Each holds original formal declarations and proofs for the Erdos-Stone-Simonovits and Kovari-Sos-Turan development, so every file stays searchable.
